summary: A coastal city in central Vietnam with a long sandy beach right in the city centre. Swim on the city beach, see the Cham Twin Towers, take a day trip to Ky Co and Eo Gio, and eat fish-cake noodle soup. Suits beach lovers and couples.

seoTitle: Quy Nhon travel guide — Ky Co, Eo Gio, the Cham towers
seoDescription: Swim the city crescent, then give a day to Kỳ Co and Eo Gió and an hour to the Cham twin towers. Seafood and the night are on Xuân Diệu.
intro: You wake on a long crescent of yellow sand, fairly clear and blue, buildings along Xuân Diệu a short walk from the water, with Kỳ Co and Eo Gió waiting a day away. Stay here when that night on the crescent is the trip. Go to Da Nang, 300 km up the coast, when that city is the trip, or continue south toward Nha Trang.

The city beach is free, open 6:00–23:00, with a listed visit of 60 minutes. Kỳ Co is a separate cove, nearly 25 km away, its own sand with hills on three sides. The distance is not split into road and boat.

Evening is Xuân Diệu, for seafood and a cafe on the sand, then Quảng trường Nguyễn Tất Thành, 6.5 ha on the avenue of that name. The square is free and open 6:00–22:00. Horse carts leave from Xuân Diệu near the square, along Xuân Diệu or An Dương Vương. The square names New Year fireworks and Festival võ Bình Định.

Cầu Thị Nại is the span on the road toward the peninsula, called the longest sea bridge, at 2,477.3 m and 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km that also has five shorter bridges. Cross by day, and again after dark when the lamps are on. The lagoon is 8 km northeast. The 7:00–18:00 line does not close the road.

A day across the bridge is Phương Mai. Eo Gió is the rock saddle: 25,000 đồng, children under 0.9 m free, open 7:00–19:00. The sunset is called the finest in Vietnam, and the sunrise is called the finest. The calm window is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay away when the sea is rough. Kỳ Co is listed at 30,000–60,000 đồng. That range is separate from Eo Gió’s 25,000 đồng.

South of the center, Ghềnh Ráng is about 3 km and free: egg-shaped stones, and the cove called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu because Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu bathed there. Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road. Inside the city, Tháp Đôi is the late-12th-century Cham pair, 20,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00, in Phường Quy Nhơn and also in phường Đống Đa. Tháp Bánh Ít, about 20 km away, is a different site.
gettingAround: The city beach is a walk from the center. Sleep on the crescent if that night is the trip. Quy Hòa and Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, are the quieter sand. Lodging there runs from homestay to resort.
Phù Cát is the airport. A flight to Hồ Chí Minh City takes 1 hour and a flight to Hà Nội takes 2 hours.

Ga Diêu Trì is the stop on the north–south railway. Ga Quy Nhơn is not a row on that table. Southbound SE7: Đà Nẵng 22:30, Diêu Trì 04:12 the next day. Northbound SE8: Sài Gòn 06:00, Diêu Trì 18:07. Extra trains SE30 and SE29 stopped at both Diêu Trì and Quy Nhơn in February and March 2025 only.

The coast road is 300 km to Đà Nẵng, 686 km to Hồ Chí Minh City, and 1,065 km from Hà Nội. Kỳ Co is nearly 25 km, and the distance is not split into road and boat. Hải Minh is about 15 minutes by boat from bến Hàm Tử.

stayAreas.name: The crescent
stayAreas.summary: Beachfront rooms along the yellow sand, a walk from the swim and from Xuân Diệu after dark. Quy Hòa and Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, are the quieter sand.

eat: Order bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ. The broth is simmered from fish bones, often tuna or sailfish, rather than pork bone, and the cakes are both fried and steamed. Some bowls leave the dill out. Some add chopped scallion and dill on the chả cá. Dip the cake in chili sauce and pickled shallot, and put the herbs in the bowl.

Bánh xèo tôm nhảy rau mầm is the thin yellow cake. The shrimp are small and turn red, with bean sprouts and scallion. Some cooks use freshwater shrimp. Some use brackish tôm đất from the Thị Nại lagoon. Wrap it with sprouts, cucumber, and star fruit, and eat it with fish sauce. The cake is on Diên Hồng and Đống Đa, and the menu also includes squid, beef, and egg.

Bún nem is noodles with nem chua, grilled fish cake, herbs, peanut, pickled mustard, and coriander, in a sour-hot-salty-sweet sauce that changes by shop. The bowl is in the center. Bánh mì lagu is a thick soup with a large piece of pork, eaten with bread, from a lane off Nguyễn Huệ.

Bánh hỏi is a morning plate from Diêu Trì, and bánh ít lá gai is the cone-shaped cake. Bún Song Thằn is in An Nhơn, nem chợ huyện in Tuy Phước, and bánh tráng nước dừa in Tam Quan. Bánh bèo is on Nguyễn Tất Thành nối dài, Nguyễn Thái Học, and Mai Xuân Thưởng.
interestsBody: The city crescent is the swim in the center. Kỳ Co is a separate cove, nearly 25 km away.
Phương Mai is the day across Thị Nại: Eo Gió’s rock saddle and Kỳ Co’s closed cove. The Eo Gió sunset is called the finest in Vietnam, and the sunrise is called the finest.
Tháp Đôi is the Cham pair inside the city. The museum on Nguyễn Huệ keeps the Cham room: five rooms, free, open 7:00–17:00.
Cầu Thị Nại is the white span, with the lamps after dark. The length is 2,477.3 m.
Ghềnh Ráng is the egg-stone cove south of the center. Bãi Xếp is 13 km farther south.
Chợ Đêm sells clothes, shoes, and souvenirs. The food corner is inside Nhà Văn hóa Lao động tỉnh, beside a walking street.

Quảng trường Nguyễn Tất Thành is 6.5 ha on the avenue of that name, free, open 6:00–22:00.

interestGroups.title: Phuong Mai for the day
interestGroups.summary: Eo Gió’s rock saddle and Kỳ Co’s closed crescent, the day across Thị Nại.
body: Eo Gió is a curved gap between two rock ridges. The fee is 25,000 đồng, and children under 0.9 m are free. It is open 7:00–19:00. The calm season is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9. Stay away when the sea is rough.

The Eo Gió sunset is called the finest in Vietnam, and the sunrise is called the finest. Kỳ Co is 30,000–60,000 đồng, and that range is not labeled as a gate, a boat, or a span of prices. The cove is in Phường Quy Nhơn Đông, and also in xã Nhơn Lý.

cards.title: Eo Gio
cards.summary: Stand in the rock saddle and look down at the sea. The fee is 25,000 đồng.

cards.title: Ky Co
cards.summary: A crescent with hills on three sides, nearly 25 km out. The price is 30,000–60,000 đồng.

interestGroups.title: Twin towers and the Cham room
interestGroups.summary: Tháp Đôi inside the city, and the Cham room at the museum on Nguyễn Huệ.
body: Tháp Đôi, also Tháp Hưng Thạnh, is a pair of late-12th-century Cham towers: a square body and a curved top, Garuda at the corners, ranked an architecture-and-art relic in 1980. The fee is 20,000 đồng. Open 7:00–18:00. The listed visit is 120 minutes. The towers are in Phường Quy Nhơn, and also in phường Đống Đa.

Bảo tàng tổng hợp Bình Định is at 26 Nguyễn Huệ. It is free, open 7:00–17:00, and holds five rooms, including a Cham room, plus sculpture in the yard. Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away and is a different visit.

cards.title: Twin towers
cards.summary: Both Cham towers, inside the city. The fee is 20,000 đồng.

interestGroups.title: The bridge after dark
interestGroups.summary: The white span across the lagoon, and the lamps after dark.
body: Afternoon light and the lamps after dark are the two times to cross. It is called the longest sea bridge, at 2,477.3 m and 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km. Crossing is free. The 7:00–18:00 field does not close the road. The lagoon is 8 km northeast.

cards.title: Thi Nai bridge
cards.summary: The white span by day, and the lamps after dark.

interestGroups.title: Queen’s cove
interestGroups.summary: Ghềnh Ráng’s egg stones, about 3 km southeast of the center.
body: Egg-shaped stones the sea has rounded line the cove called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu, because Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu bathed here. Also here: a Vọng Phu rock, a lion-shaped rock, bãi tắm Tiên Sa, and Hàn Mặc Tử’s grave on the hillside. Bảo Đại chose Ghềnh Ráng as a royal retreat from 1927. The visit is free, open 7:00–18:00. The area is about 3 km southeast.
Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on quốc lộ 1D, two crescent beaches in a fishing village.

cards.summary: Walk the egg stones and the cove called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Quy Nhon or Da Nang?
faqs.a: Stay here when the night on the crescent and Xuân Diệu is the trip. Go to Da Nang when that city is the trip. The coast road between them is 300 km.

faqs.q: What do the Kỳ Co and Cù Lao Xanh price fields buy?
faqs.a: Kỳ Co is listed at 30,000–60,000 đồng, and Cù Lao Xanh at 200,000–350,000 đồng. Neither figure says whether it is a gate, a boat, or a range. Eo Gió is a separate ticket, 25,000 đồng.

faqs.q: Is the city still Quy Nhon?
faqs.a: Quy Nhơn is described as the center of Bình Định, at 6,039.56 km² and 1,500,000 people. A 22 Apr 2025 draft described a merged province named Gia Lai, with the administrative center at present-day Quy Nhơn, about 21,576 km² and more than 3.1 million people. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 is dated 12 June 2025.

faqs.q: When is the Nước Mặn festival?
faqs.a: In 2025 the public days were 27 Feb–1 Mar, lunar 30th of the first month through the 2nd of the second month, Ất Tỵ. The place is thôn An Hòa, xã Phước Quang, huyện Tuy Phước, not the city beach. The festival is national intangible heritage, recognized in 2022.

Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away, 15,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00. The Quang Trung museum is about 45 km northwest, 15,000 đồng, open 7:00–18:00. Trung Lương is free, and also 40,000 đồng including a shower, children under 1 m free. Xuân Diệu’s childhood house is at Gò Bồi, not the beach street. Quảng Ngãi and Sông Cầu are the coast on either side.
